name: Education
blurb: Schools, universities, teaching methods and access to learning. A Task 2 favourite.

name: Work & Careers
blurb: Jobs, promotion, working conditions and the changing workplace.

name: Business & Economy
blurb: Markets, trade, consumers and money. Also essential for describing trends in Task 1.

name: Technology
blurb: AI, the internet, social media, privacy and the digital divide.

name: Environment
blurb: Climate change, pollution, wildlife and sustainability.

name: Health & Fitness
blurb: Diet, exercise, stress, healthcare systems and lifestyle.

name: Crime & Law
blurb: Punishment, prisons, policing and why people commit crime.

name: Family & Relationships
blurb: Parenting, friendship, generations and social life. Very common in Speaking Part 1 and 2.

name: Travel & Tourism
blurb: Holidays, tourism's impact and adventure. Ideal for Speaking Part 2 'describe a trip'.

name: Cities & Housing
blurb: Urbanisation, transport, housing costs and city versus countryside.

name: Media & Advertising
blurb: News, social media, advertising and freedom of the press.

name: Globalisation & Culture
blurb: Cultural identity, migration, languages and global trade.

name: Government & Society
blurb: Public spending, inequality, policy and social problems.

name: Science & Research
blurb: Research, ethics, space exploration and scientific progress.

name: Arts, Sport & Leisure
blurb: Hobbies, the arts, sport and free time. A frequent Speaking Part 1 and 2 theme.

name: Essay & Opinion Toolkit
blurb: Cross-topic language for giving opinions, discussing problems and communicating ideas. Works in any Task 2 essay.
